providers.title: Poincaré duality
providers.scope: R-oriented topological n-manifolds, any commutative ring R: the cap product with the orientation classes is an isomorphism from compactly supported cohomology in degree k to homology in degree n-k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Self-injective coefficients
providers.scope: A commutative ring injective over itself, for example Z/m, and a manifold oriented over it: ordinary cohomology in degree k is the dual of compactly supported cohomology in degree n-k; over Z/m finite groups have equal orders.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Dimension
providers.scope: Every n-manifold: integral homology vanishes above degree n and is free in degree n; cohomology with any coefficient group vanishes above degree n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Complex orientation
providers.scope: Complex manifolds of complex dimension d: a canonical orientation as real 2d-manifolds, given by the standard orientation in every holomorphic chart.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Classes on compact subsets
providers.scope: n-manifolds, compact subsets K, any commutative ring: homology relative to the complement of K vanishes above degree n, and a locally consistent family of local classes comes from a unique class.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Duality and Mayer–Vietoris
providers.scope: R-oriented manifolds and open covers by two sets: the duality maps commute with the Mayer–Vietoris sequences, the connecting square up to the sign (-1)^(i+1).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sheaf and singular cohomology
providers.scope: Topological manifolds and their open subsets, any abelian group: the sheaf of singular cochains is a flasque resolution of the constant sheaf, and sheaf cohomology is singular cohomology.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Supports
providers.scope: Closed subsets Z of a manifold: sheaf cohomology with supports in Z is singular cohomology relative to the complement of Z.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extension by zero into a compact space
providers.scope: An open embedding j of a manifold into a compact Hausdorff space and any sheaf F: the cohomology of j_!F is the compactly supported cohomology of F.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Duality for sheaf cohomology
providers.scope: Manifolds oriented over a self-injective ring such as Z/m, for example complex manifolds: sheaf cohomology in degree q is the dual of compactly supported sheaf cohomology in degree n-q.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
